No payment is taken until you approve the plan. Common questions

On this walk you examine urban mosques and the Jahanpanah landscape.

The date, start time, pace and language are arranged to suit your group.

What it covers

  • Begumpur courtyard approach
  • Eastern entrance
  • Prayer-hall exterior/interior open areas
  • Neighbourhood interface

How the time is spent

  1. Begumpur courtyard approach 15 min

    Place monument in Jahanpanah.

    You: map dynasties

  2. Eastern entrance 30 min

    Examine urban entrance logic.

    You: sketch threshold

  3. Prayer-hall exterior/interior open areas 30 min

    Compare arches, domes and mosque plan.

    You: plan labeling

  4. Neighbourhood interface 15 min

    Discuss conservation in dense city fabric.

    You: document observations

Timings are a guide. The plan is confirmed with your quotation.

By the end you can

  • Identify and interpret key features of Begumpur Mosque using material evidence and a site map.
  • Examine urban mosques and the Jahanpanah landscape.
  • Distinguish directly visible fabric from reconstructed or debated historical claims.

You take away

Your annotated field card, sketches and notes.

Where
Begumpur, Delhi
For

What to bring
Comfortable shoes, water and a hat. The ground is uneven in places.
Entry fees
Monument entry fees, where charged, are not included.
